description: This file defines the Coocook::Schema class, which extends DBIx::Class::Schema::Config, providing database schema configuration and utility methods for a Perl project using DBIx::Class ORM. It includes methods for connection handling, statistics, and database-specific operations for PostgreSQL and SQLite.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema
classes.description: A schema class extending DBIx::Class::Schema::Config, providing database connection management, statistics, and database-specific operations.

methods.name: connection
methods.description: Overrides the default connection method to set default connection options, such as enabling foreign keys in SQLite.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of records across specified resultsets or all resultsets if none specified.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Returns a hashref with site-wide statistics such as dishes served, recipes, projects, users, and organizations.

methods.name: pgsql_reset_sequence_values
methods.description: Resets sequence values in PostgreSQL to match the current maximum ID in each sequence.

methods.name: pgsql_set_constraints_deferred
methods.description: Sets all constraints to deferred in PostgreSQL.

methods.name: fk_checks_off_do
methods.description: Temporarily disables foreign key checks in SQLite, runs a provided code reference, then restores the original state.

methods.name: fk_checks_off_guard
methods.description: Returns a Scope::Guard object that disables foreign key checks in SQLite within its scope.

methods.name: enable_fk_checks
methods.description: Enables foreign key checks in SQLite.

methods.name: disable_fk_checks
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks in SQLite.

methods.name: sqlite_pragma
methods.description: Gets or sets a SQLite PRAGMA value.
